chapters.label: Lens, 1998
chapters.text: Lens, 1998. France against Paraguay, nil–nil in extra time. The next goal wins! Pirès crosses, Trezeguet heads it down... Laurent Blanc scores!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Blanc is a defender, but he stays up front. His teammates wave him back... but he waits for his chance.

chapters.label: First time
chapters.text: Here comes the header down. Blanc hits it first time, with his right foot, before it can bounce again. The first golden goal in World Cup history!

chapters.label: Be ready
chapters.text: Defenders who join the attack late are hard to mark. Be ready, and finish first time!
